newsitem.title: USA: CNB Financial raises qtly div to $0.12/shr.
newsitem.headline: CNB Financial raises qtly div to $0.12/shr.

text.p: CNB Financial Corp said on Wednesday it raised its quarterly dividend to $0.12 from $0.113.
The previous dividend has been adjusted for a three-for-two stock split in January 1997.
The first quarter dividend is payable March 10 to shareholders of record February 28, and is 9.0 pct higher than in the first quarter a year ago.
The company also said it plans to repurchase up to 236,000 of its outstanding shares in the open market during the period March 15, 1997 to March 15, 1998.
The company said the shares will be purchased at prevailing market prices from time to time depending upon market conditions.

CNB said the repurchased shares will be held in treasury, but may be reissued in the future in connection with the company's dividend reinvestment plan, or to satisfy the issuing of stock options, as well as other corporate purposes such as acquisitions.
